name: resume-retry-fires-only-once
description: When the fresh retry also exits before init, PowerUp does not retry again: the failure is reported as an unexpected end and no third start is made.
reason: The retry exists for stale ids only. A harness that cannot start at all (bad binary, not logged in) must surface as an error instead of a restart loop.
source: DESIGN.md core rule 'retry ONCE without resumeSessionID'; AppState.handleTermination

script.reason: App launch resumes the saved conversation.
The resume fails before init; this is the one retry.
The fresh start fails too; there is no second retry.

transcript.text: Couldn't resume the previous session — starting a fresh one.
